device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU
measurement: Synthetic single-GPU TreeRL ReinforceTrainer status path with two CUDA loss metrics and eight CPU replay-info metrics. The legacy path materializes tensors then copies/reduces ten fields independently. The packed path reduces one FP32 vector and copies it to CPU once. World-size-one all_reduce is an identity; model work and multi-rank collective latency are excluded.
